basics.name: Hugo Garrido-Lestache Belinchon
basics.label: M.S. Machine Learning Student
basics.summary: Interested in AI, Reinforcement Learning, and cooperative multi‑agent systems; 1st in NVIDIA ROSIE Supercomputer Challenge. Published author attending ICMLA 2025.

work.name: MSOE
work.summary: Developing TAAC, a novel Multi‑Agent Reinforcement Learning algorithm to promote collaboration.
highlights: Used self-play, curriculum learning, and attention-based actor-critic methods to achieve state-of-the-art performance in soccer and tower-building environments.
Published at ICMLA 2025; presented research and released code and blog.
Came 1st in the MSOE NVIDIA ROSIE Supercomputer Challenge, winning over $9,000 in prizes.

work.name: Direct Supply
work.summary: Built and improved AI systems for product data: web scraping, linking, and tagging.
highlights: Reverse Image Search: Prototyped a system to search for products by image for faster retrieval and matching.
AI Product Web Scraper: Created an AI tool to search, parse and combine unstructured data on the internet to augment the company’s quality and quantity of data.
AI Product Linking: Improved AI systems to match products together based on semantic similarity.
AI Product Tagging: Created a System to add tags/attributes to products automatically based on product data. This data can be used to group and filter products and feed future AI Models.
Developed and Deployed to AWS Full-Stack (FastAPI/React) web application prototypes.
Heavily utilized OpenAI and Groq, pre-trained LLMs and embedding models.

work.name: MSOE
work.summary: Tutored approximately 20 students weekly in programming concepts.

volunteer.summary: Mentoring undergraduates on AI. 2025 cohort built a CNN; 2026 projects include agentic video segmentation, stock prediction, and image colorization.
Planned events and taught skills to scouts (20–25 youth).
